content.short: Business account, invoicing, cards and expense tools.
content.description: Finom is a European business banking platform built for freelancers, startups, and small companies that want banking and finance admin in one place. From a single account it offers local IBANs, physical and virtual cards, integrated invoicing, expense management, and accounting integrations, helping business owners get paid, control spend, and stay on top of bookkeeping without juggling separate tools. Operating across multiple European markets from its Netherlands base, Finom emphasizes fast onboarding, cashback on card spend, and automation that reduces manual admin for lean teams. By combining a business account with invoicing and expense features, Finom positions itself as an all-in-one alternative to traditional business banking for Europe's small enterprises.
